patterns.note: A clean, single-column layout for main content blocks, with a multi-column grid for the 'AREAS OF WORK' project showcase that adapts responsively.
A highly distinctive, elegant display serif font is used for all major headings and hero text, creating a strong brand identity, while body text uses a clean, modern sans-serif.
Predominantly monochrome (black text on white/light background) for the site's structural elements, allowing the vibrant, diverse colors within the project images to stand out as focal points.
A sticky header navigation remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent access to primary links.
Use of hand-drawn, abstract line art illustrations as decorative elements, particularly in the hero and as subtle dividers, adding a unique artistic and conceptual touch.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed header navigation that stays at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring constant access to primary links.

Content sections are revealed by standard vertical scrolling, with no complex scroll-triggered animations or staggered fade-ins for individual elements. The hero section's large text and line art simply scroll off-screen.
The project showcase uses a responsive grid layout, displaying project cards in multiple columns that adapt to screen size, each featuring a distinct visual and a brief description.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, elegant display serif headings (hero text is ~4-5x body text) with generous line height, contrasted with smaller, highly legible sans-serif body and label text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy and spacious, particularly in the hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of calm and luxury.

standout: The site's distinctive use of elegant, high-contrast display serif typography combined with minimalist line art illustrations creates a sophisticated, almost editorial aesthetic that feels more like a design portfolio than a typical corporate site.
